# Real test photos

Photos by the repository owner, added on 2026-11-12 as test data. They are the images the host receives
(1152 × 1536 or 1536 × 1152, sRGB PNG); they carry no location or camera data.

| File | Note |
|---|---|
| `01_building.png` | original of taste sample 01 |
| `02_night_tower.png` | original of taste sample 02 |
| `museum_glass_lotus.png`, `museum_glass_sunflowers.png`, `museum_glass_orchid_panels.png` | glass exhibits in dark cases |
| `interior_arcade.png` | indoor arcade under a lit roof |

Do not change these files: the tests compare against them. To add a photo, add a new file.
